tasks.pairing: same seed, same tier, same embodiment, teleport reset, realistic verifier (oracle as held-out scorer)

equivalence.rule: absolute difference of paired success rates

exclusions: infrastructure_invalid (confinement or launcher failure) with one retry of the same seed
acceptance.retry_rule: one retry of the same seed after an infrastructure-invalid record; the invalid run stays in the record

commands.typed: uv run harness rollout --graph graphs/pilot_t1_l2_typed.yaml --tier T1 --perception L2 --verifier realistic --episodes 8 --seeds 0..7
commands.monolithic: uv run harness monolith run --module experts/monolithic/expert_t1_l2.py --template graphs/pilot_t1_l2_monolithic.yaml --verifier realistic --tier T1 --episodes 8 --seeds 0..7

acceptance.note: The two preconditions marked false are honest: both experts were authored by the same maintainer with full repository access, and the seed set was chosen by that author. Runs against this protocol are engineering shakeouts (MON-11 expert_parity purpose) and cannot pass the gate until an independent author and operator exist.

stopping_rule: all listed seeds run once per arm; no post-result additions
